marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Tech & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: Major Hong Kong-listed technology giants saw increased institutional capital inflows following reports of expanded capital expenditure commitments towards AI infrastructure and cloud deployment.
marketLayer.inference: Accelerated AI infrastructure spending is expected to drive medium-term revenue re-acceleration for cloud platforms and enterprise software providers in the HKEX ecosystem.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization timelines for AI application layers and potential price competition in public cloud services.

marketLayer.title: US Monetary Policy & Semiconductor Valuation
marketLayer.fact: U.S. macroeconomic data indicated moderating inflation alongside steady job growth, reinforcing expectations of near-term rate adjustments and supporting gains across the Nasdaq and S&P 500.
marketLayer.inference: A lower yield environment reduces discount rates for high-growth tech firms, maintaining elevated valuation multiples for major semiconductor design and hardware vendors.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Persistent service-sector inflation risks and potential shifts in Federal Reserve tone at upcoming FOMC meetings.

marketLayer.title: Dual-Listed EV Makers & Global Trade Policies
marketLayer.fact: Dual-listed Chinese electric vehicle manufacturers reported robust monthly delivery volume growth, driven by new model launches and overseas expansion strategies.
marketLayer.inference: Export market penetration helps offset domestic price war pressures, supporting gross margin defense for tier-one EV producers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Implementation details of foreign trade tariffs and regulatory shifts in European and North American import markets.
